For KDM3A interactome, RPE1WT (in duplicate), RPE1WTcr, and KDM3Anull (line 2, in triplicate) cells were plated the day before and grown in the absence of serum for 3 h, lysed in 50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 10% glycerol, 5 mM EDTA, 0.5% IGEPAL, and protease inhibitors and incubated with N-KDM3A antibody (12835; Proteintech) for 2 h at 4°C followed by 15-min incubation with PureProteome magnetic beads (EMD Millipore) to concentrate the immunoglobulin complexes.
